definitions.gloss: to see off; to bid farewell
definitions.explanation: To accompany someone to their departure point and watch them leave.
To decide not to proceed with something at this time.

definitions.gloss: to let pass; to pass on
definitions.explanation: To deliberately not take action on an opportunity.

notes:
{見送|みおく}る is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) formed from ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see) + ⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send off). It has both literal and figurative meanings.

ASPECT (ている):
{見送|みおく}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates the ongoing action of watching someone leave, or that something has been put on hold.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [person]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見送|みおく}る — to see [person] off
- [plan/opportunity]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見送|みおく}る — to postpone/pass on [plan/opportunity]
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{見送|みおく}る (see off to the station)
- ⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見送|みおく}る (postpone purchasing)
- ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見送|みおく}る (pass on this opportunity)

BUSINESS/FORMAL USE:
{見送|みおく}る is commonly used in business contexts to mean declining or postponing something politely.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧: to stare at, gaze at (different meaning)
- ⟦{見逃|みのが}す→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧: to overlook, miss
